## Question 3:

### Create a data frame of only the country where the cases are for 1999 and 2000. Display the results in a chart of your choice:

```{python}
# Question 3 Code
print(df)

cases_df = (df
  .drop("population")
  .pivot(
    "year",
    index="country",
    values="cases"
  )
)

cases_df

```
